name: flaggems_normal_
description: Extracted from FlagGems normal_ (in-place fill with N(mean,std)).
reference:
import torch

def run(x, mean, std):
    return x.normal_(mean, std)

def valid(ref_outputs, sol_outputs, inputs, ctx):
    out = sol_outputs[0] if isinstance(sol_outputs, (list, tuple)) else sol_outputs
    mean = ctx['mean']
    std = ctx['std']
    of = out.float()
    m = of.mean().item()
    s = of.std().item()
    ok_mean = abs(m - mean) < 0.2
    ok_std = abs(s - std) < 0.2
    passed = bool(ok_mean and ok_std)
    return {'passed': passed, 'message': f'mean={m:.4f} (target {mean}), std={s:.4f} (target {std})', 'metrics': {'mean': m, 'std': s}}
